_description: Language layer. Selected language objects are sent as the copy request languages list. Empty fields are omitted. Studio chips come from _modes. _persona_source_map is this brand's seed-field aliases.

EN.label: English
rules: Write fully English ad copy. Do not use Hindi words or romanized Hindi (Hinglish).
Do not mix Devanagari into English lines.
Do not transliterate Hindi sentences into English letters.

persona_fallbacks.pain_en: The current routine is difficult to sustain.
persona_fallbacks.desire_en: A practical routine that fits daily life.
persona_fallbacks.friction_en: Past approaches felt difficult to maintain.

HI.label: Hindi
rules: Write fully Hindi in Devanagari script.
Do not write Hindi in Roman letters. That is Hinglish, not Hindi.
Do not mix Latin words into a Hindi line unless the product name requires the original spelling.
Keep the same meaning as the English version without translating word for word.

HINGLISH.label: Hinglish
rules: Write spoken Hindi in Roman letters, mixed naturally with English.
Keep it conversational. Do not produce a word-for-word English translation written in Hindi words.
Do not make English-only copy and call it Hinglish.
